findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: The soda dispenser nozzles of the soda machine in the lobby area were observed to have significant filth accumulation. PIC was notified and nozzles were cleaned and reinstalled during the inspection to correct the violation.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: 1) Both vents of the ceiling in the storage area was observed to have excessive dust accumulation. 2) Also observed was a spot on the ceiling near the mop sink area that seemed to have been soiled from a previous splash. The PIC was made aware cleaning should be conducted prior to the next routine inspection and maintained.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.12 Cleaning, Frequency and Restrictions. (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment: Observed 3 door cooler to be soiled with food debris. Discussed with PIC, cooler will be cleaned. Ensure facility is cleaning non food contact surfaces at a frequency that prevents food accumulation.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(C) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment:
(Repeatx2) Observed the following physical facility areas in need of repairs:
1. Multiple areas of the facility need re-caulked: the prep sink in the back, the back triple sink, and the mop sink. All areas have black mold present. 
2.Liner on shelving unit next to the triple sink is broken and has holes. Replace liner. 
3. The wall paper in the women’s bathroom is severely fraying in multiple places. Wall paper needs resealed or replaced. Walls should be smooth and easily cleanable. 

Discussed with PIC, repairs will be made. Ensure physical facility is being monitored at a frequency that prevents the need for physical facility repairs.
findings.citation_text: 6-201.11 Floors, Walls, and Ceilings. Except as specified under § 6-201.14 and except for antislip floor coverings or applications that may be used for safety reasons, floors, floor coverings, walls, wall coverings, and ceilings shall be designed, constructed, and installed so they are SMOOTH and EASILY CLEANABLE.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.comment:
2-301.12: (A) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of arms for at least 20 seconds. (B) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall use proper procedure (C) To prevent recontamination, FOOD EMPLOYEES may use barrier to operate faucet handles. (D) Automatic handwashing facility may be used if APPROVED. 

Observed the CFPM to improperly wash hands. Ensure a barrier is used such as a paper towel to prevent cross contamination. Employee properly washed hands and did not use a barrier to turn off the faucet handles. Discussed with CFPM. Ensure staff is aware to use a barrier such as a paper towel to turn off the faucet handles after appropriate hand washing. COS.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. 

(REPEAT) Observed the following food-contact surfaces soiled with debris, grease, food splash, etc.:
1. Interior of the fryers have an accumulation of fresh fries, grease, and salt throughout. Pest harborage concerns from amount of food debris. Ensure staff is routinely opening and cleaning the interior of the fryer (fryer is frequently used and therefore needs consistent cleaning) - wash, rinse, sanitize. Fryer was professionally cleaned last year after last routine inspection and follow-up’s.
2. The metal shelving unit across from the 3 compartment sink is storing clean cookware and utensils. Layer of food splash and debris on the grating. The shelving unit needs cleaned. Utensils are in contact with the dirty area. Wash, rinse, sanitize the shelving unit. The unit is tacky and sticky to touch.

Discussed with PIC. Inspector will follow-up on 2/15/23. Ensure above areas are cleaning. Both #1 and #2 are repeat violations since the last routine inspection on 2/9/23.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-201.11: Except as specified under § 6-201.14 and except for antislip floor coverings or applications that may be used for safety reasons, floors, floor coverings, walls, wall coverings, and ceilings shall be designed, constructed, and installed so they are SMOOTH and EASILY CLEANABLE. 

(REPEAT) Observed the following physical facility areas in need of repairs:
1. Multiple areas of the facility need re-caulked: the front hand sink near cash register (interior creases and sink to wall - coming away), prep sink in back, 3 compartment sink, and the mop sink. All areas had molded, black caulking from water exposure and need re-caulked.
2. Liner on shelving unit next to the 3 compartment sink (to the left when facing the sink) is broken and has holes. Replace the liner.
3. The wall paper in the women’s bathroom is severely fraying in multiple places. Wall paper needs resealed or replaced. Walls should be smooth and easily cleanable.

Discussed repairs with PIC. Repair by the next routine inspection. All 3 issues are repeat violations since the last routine inspection on 2/9/23.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

The above issues with the fryers and shelving are still present. Inspector will follow-up on 3/16/23.

Interior fryers are still matted with grease. Shelving unit still sticky to touch and visible food debris.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

Inspector will follow-up on areas again (interior fryers and shelving units) on 3/3/23.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. 

Observed the following food-contact areas in needs of cleaning (wash, rinse, sanitize):
1. Bottom reach-in cooler (smallest one near cash register that stores cut meats) had excessive food debris towards the back on the lip/ledge. PIC cleaned during the inspection. Ensure staff is aware to clean the entire bottom of the prep coolers, not just the base.
2. Interior of the fryers has a huge accumulation of old French fries. The entire interior of the fryers need cleaned. Grease accumulation and excessive food debris. Pest harborage concerns. Ensure staff is routinely opening the fryer doors and washing, rinsing, and sanitizing interior. 
3. The metal shelving unit across from the 3 compartment sink is storing clean cookware and utensils. Thick layer of food splash and debris on the grating. The shelving unit needs cleaned. Utensils are in contact with the dirty area. Wash, rinse, sanitize the utensils after cleaning self.

Discussed with PIC. Inspector will follow-up on 2/20/23.

findings.title: Thermometers provided & accurate
findings.comment:
4-204.112: (A) In refrigerated or hot FOOD storage unit, TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICE shall be located to measure air temperature. (B) EQUIPMENT holding TCS FOOD shall have TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICE affixed to device. (C) Does not apply to EQUIPMENT without practical means of measuring ambient air surroundings. (D) TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICES shall be designed to be easily readable. C (E) FOOD and water TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICES shall have numerical scale, printed record, or digital readout in increments no greater than 1C or 2F in the intended range of use. Pf

Observed multiple reach-in coolers/prep coolers to lack thermometers. Employee went to GFS during the inspection to purchase more. Keep extra on hand and replace as needed. All cold holding units should have thermometers. Discussed with PIC. COS.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
4-302.14: A test kit or other device that accurately measures the concentration in MG/L of SANITIZING solutions shall be provided. 

Observed no quaternary ammonium test strips at the facility. Facility is utilizing quat for sanitizer in sani buckets and 3 compartment sink. Facility only had multiple packages of chlorine bleach test strips. Employee went to GFS during inspection and purchased quat test strips. Discussed with PIC that facility should have test strips during all hours of operation and be utilizing them as needed to check sanitization concentration. Quaternary ammonium levels - 200 to 400 ppm. Change within 4-6 hours or as needed to keep concentration accurate. COS.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-201.11: Except as specified under § 6-201.14 and except for antislip floor coverings or applications that may be used for safety reasons, floors, floor coverings, walls, wall coverings, and ceilings shall be designed, constructed, and installed so they are SMOOTH and EASILY CLEANABLE. 

Observed the following physical facility repairs that need to be completed:
1. Multiple areas of her facility need re-caulked: front hand sink near cash register, prep sink in back, 3 compartment sink, and the mop sink. All areas had molded, black caulking from water exposure and needed re-caulked. 
2. Liner on shelving unit next to 3 compartment sink (to the left when facing it) is broken and has holes. Replace the liner.
3. The wall paper in the women’s bathroom is severely fraying in multiple places. Wall paper needs resealed or replaced. Walls should be smooth and easily cleanable.

Discussed building repairs with PIC. Ensure all repairs occur before next routine inspection.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
5-202.12: (A) HANDWASHING SINK shall be equipped to provide water of a temperature at least 100F through mixing valve. Pf (B) Steam mixing valve may not be used. (C) A self-closing, slow-closing, or metered faucet shall provide at least 15 seconds of flowing water. (D) An automatic sink shall be installed to manufacturer’s guidelines. 

The hand sink in the mens bathroom is observed without hot water during the inspection. The PIC believed that they could repair the sink during the inspection. Sink repairs completed prior to inspector concluding the inspection and hot water available.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. 

The nozzles on the fountain drink machine are observed soiled. PIC stated that they are soaked every night and cleaned thoroughly approximately every 4 days. Inspector suggests thorough cleaning often enough to prevent accumulation. The nozzles were removed and cleaned during the inspection to correct.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing. 

The ceiling vents in the employee only area of the facility are observed with an accumulation of dust hanging from it. PIC is instructed to clean often enough to prevent accumulation.

findings.title: Single-use/single-service articles: properly stored and used
findings.citation_text:
4-903.11 (C) (C) SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES shall be stored as specified under ¶ (A) of this section and shall be kept in the original protective PACKAGE or stored by using other means that afford protection from contamination until used. 

The container used for storing single service knives for self service by consumers was visibly soiled on the bottom. The container was cleaned during the inspection.

findings.title: Plumbing installed; proper backflow devices
findings.citation_text:
5-205.15  (B) (C) PLUMBING SYSTEM shall be maintained in good repair.

The backflow prevention device on the faucet at the mop sink was observed damaged during the inspection. The situation was discussed with the PIC and they were instructed to repair and maintain the backflow prevention devices in the facility.

findings.title: Original container, properly labeled, consumer advisory
findings.comment:
750-130f Unless its identity is unmistakable, bulk food such as cooking oil, syrup, salt, sugar or flour not stored in the product container or package in which it was obtained, shall be stored in a container identifying the food by common name.
Discovered a plastic container filed with a white powered to be stored without a label. Discussed with the person in charge and discovered that it was sugar intended for tea. Discussed the importance of labeling containers of foods not in their original container and instructed to label.

findings.title: Cold food at proper temperatures during storage, display, service, transport, and cold holding
findings.comment:
750-120(a) Potentially hazardous foods, shall be maintained at a proper product temperature at all times during storage (41°F or below, or 135°F or above).

Observed sliced tomatoes in the prep cooler to be probed at 53 degrees Fahrenheit.  Potentially hazardous foods should be maintained cold at 41 degrees or lower to prevent pathogen growth. Tomatoes were discarded during the inspection.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment: 750-800(b) To prevent cross contamination, kitchenware and food contact surfaces of equipment shall be washed, rinsed, and sanitized after each use. During inspection, the nozzles for the soda machine were observed to have a build up inside of the spouts. Directed the manager to wash rinse and sanitize them at regular intervals (suggested nightly).

findings.title: Single service items properly stored, handled, dispensed
findings.comment: 750-880 Single-service articles shall be handled and dispensed in a manner which prevents contamination of surfaces which may come in contact with food or with the mouth of the user. Kids cups were prepared ahead of time (straws placed in the lids and lids on the cups) with gloves on, and left on the counter next to the cash register. When discussed with management, decided that leaving the lids pre-strawed under the counter and away from possible contaminates was sufficient to prevent contamination.

findings.title: Plumbing installed and maintained
findings.comment: 750-1060 All plumbing shall be sized, installed, and maintained in accordance with applicable provisions of the Illinois State Plumbing Code. Repair fixtures in accordance with the Illinois Plumbing Code. During the inspection, observed one of the hand washing sinks not having hot water, or water at pressure from the hot water handle. Suggested having it looked at by a plumber to determine the issue and fix.

findings.title: Hands washed, good hygienic practices (observed).
findings.comment: 750-510a Observed staff switching tasks between cleaning and sanitizing meat slicer and donning gloves for sandwich creation without washing hands. Multiple employees moved from other tasks to glove use without first washing their hands. Discussed handwashing with staff.  Employees shall properly wash their hands any time their hands may have become contaminated and prior to handling food or clean equipment.

findings.title: Wiping cloths clean, used properly, stored
findings.comment: 750-810b Observed a wet wiping cloth on the counter by the meat slicer. Cloth was stored in sani-bucket during the inspection. Cease storing wet wiping cloths on counters. The cloths should be stored in sani-solution between uses to help eliminate pathogen growth. Moist cloths used for wiping food spills on kitchenware and food-contact surfaces shall be clean and rinsed frequently in one of the permitted sanitizing solutions. See Section 750.820e.   These cloths shall be stored in a proper sanitizing solution between uses.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
Observed the ice chute to have some mold accumulation. The ice dispenser was cleaned during the inspection.
750-800(b) To prevent cross contamination, kitchenware and food contact surfaces of equipment shall be washed, rinsed, and sanitized after each use.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
Observed the tray of the soda machine drain to have some mold accumulation. Clean the non-food contact surfaces.
750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Sanitizing concentration
findings.comment:
Observed the sanitizer bucket used for food contact surfaces to be 0ppm. The sanitizer bucket was remade during the inspection to measure 100-200 ppm Chlorine.
750-800c Where equipment and utensils are used for the preparation of  potentially hazardous foods on a continuous or production-line basis, utensils and the food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized at intervals throughout the day on a schedule subject to the approval of the regulatory authority.  This schedule shall be based on food temperature, type of food, and amount of food particle accumulation.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
Observed the inside of the fryers to be soiled with food debris. Clean the non-food contact surfaces.
750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.comment:
Observed cookies for "free cookie Tuesday" were stored unprotected on top of the soda boxes.  Make sure to protect the food during storage at all times.
750-120(a) Food shall be protected at all times. Properly store and protect food.

findings.title: Presence of insects/rodents.  Animals prohibited
findings.comment:
Observed a some fruit flies at the soda machine and the mop sink. It is recommended to increase pest control. Make sure to clean the non-food contact surfaces as needed around these areas.
750-1160 Effective measures to minimize the presence of rodents and insects shall be utilized. Provide effective pest control.

findings.title: Toxic items labeled and used properly
findings.comment:
Observed two chemical bottles that had no label.  The bottles were labeled during the inspection.
750-1300 Containers of poisonous or toxic materials necessary for the maintenance of the establishment shall be labeled in accordance with law. Properly label containers of toxic substances.

findings.title: Hands washed, good hygienic practices (observed).
findings.comment:
Observed an employee wash his hands improperly (touched the faucet to turn off after washing hands). The manager was made aware of the situation and spoke with the employee about proper handwashing.  Hands must be properly washed at all times.
750-510d To avoid re-contaminating their hands, food employees shall use disposable paper towels or similar clean barriers when touching surfaces such as manually operated faucet handles on a hand-washing sink or the handle of a restroom door.

findings.title: Water source safe, hot, and cooled under pressure
findings.comment:
Observed no cold water at the front handsink.  Hot and cold water should be accessible at every handsink. Provide cold water.
750-1120 Each lavatory shall be provided with hot and cold water tempered by means of a mixing valve or combination faucet.

findings.title: In-use food dispensing utensils properly stored.
findings.comment:
Observed a cup stored in steak seasonings.  Scoops should be used and extended out of the food to protect from cross contamination.  Cup was removed during the inspection to correct the violation. (IMMEDIATELY CORRECTED)
750-280 Food dispensing utensils shall be stored in the food with the handle extending out of the food; or stored clean and dry; or stored in running potable water dipper wells.

findings.title: Wiping cloths clean, used properly, stored
findings.comment:
Observed one wet wiping cloth stored on the counter.   Wet wiping cloths must be stored in a sanitizer solution when not in use.  Cloth was put in a sanitizer solution to correct the violation. (IMMEDIATELY CORRECTED)
750-810b Moist cloths used for wiping food spills on kitchenware and food-contact surfaces shall be clean and rinsed frequently in one of the permitted sanitizing solutions. See Section 750.820e.   These cloths shall be stored in a proper sanitizing solution between uses.
